WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) as avg_round_circuit
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(r.round) as avg_round_country
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT s1.circuitId, s1.country, s1.avg_round_circuit, s1.avg_round_circuit - s2.avg_round_country as diff
FROM step1 s1
JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.country = s2.country
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
